description:
QR/barcode e-tickets, anti-screenshot rotating barcodes, static PDF fallback, provider-abstracted mailer (log transport locally).

**Conditions of Success:**
- Tickets deliver by email and in the web wallet; re-send and re-retrieve by order reference
- Rotating barcode mode invalidates screenshots (time-boxed codes); PDF mode stays static by choice
- Mailer is a port: log transport locally, real provider swappable

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
